proposal.reason: Primary change is in communicator configuration lifecycle: new/validated config fields (nChannelsPerNetPeer, graphUsageMode, maxP2pPeers, plus nvlinkCentricSched/numRmaCtx acceptance), env overrides, defaults, and cross-rank propagation in init/comm config paths. Enqueue is additionally needed because strong-stream/graph-capture behavior is materially changed to support graph/non-graph mixing modes (new graphUsageMode plumbing and conditional synchronization semantics in strongstream and enqueue/channel call sites). Device-topology is additionally needed because P2P channel computation logic in src/graph/paths.cc now uses communicator config (network peer channel count and max peer budget) to alter channel-per-peer and multi-node tuning behavior.
